reference.question: What is the maximum value of \(y=2\sin x\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Read the amplitude

\(A=2>0\), so the maximum value is the amplitude, \(2\).

Method 2: Bound the sine and attain the bound

The sine function never exceeds \(1\), so \(2\sin x\le2\) for every real \(x\). At \(x=\pi/2\), \(\sin x=1\), so this bound is attained. Therefore the maximum value is \(2\).
